name: The Consequence Protocol
subtitle: Putting the weight back in your word -- so your actions teach you who you are.
toc_note: Read it with a pen. Part I will cost you an honest hour. Part VII takes two questions a night, and the second one has to have a real answer.
back_line: Unenforced standards aren't standards. They're wishes wearing conviction's clothing.
back_sub: If you keep breaking promises to yourself and nothing happens, you've stopped believing your own word, and you're the last to know. This is how to put the weight back.
